biography.background: Conservative talk radio host turned politician. Texas State Senator District 7 (2007-2015). Lt. Governor since 2015 — seeking 4th term. As Lt. Gov, controls Texas Senate agenda. Trump's Religious Liberty Commission leader (2025). One of the most powerful figures in Texas politics.

policyPositions.position: NRA A+ grade. Controlled agenda for campus carry, open carry, permitless carry (HB 1927). Brief 2019 background-check advocacy abandoned; long-term NRA A+ record dominates.
Pro-life. Controlled agenda for SB 8 (heartbeat), trigger law. Life of the Mother Act (SB 31). Taxpayer-Funded Abortion Travel Ban (SB 33). Texas Right to Life 111-138% index.
Named school choice as highest legislative priority. Pushed $1B ESA/voucher program (SB 2) through Senate. Foundational issue.
$18B property tax cut. Named property tax relief as 2027 interim charge priority.
Aggressive enforcement. Interim charges include border security. Aligned with Trump on immigration.
Texas Energy Fund ($10B for gas plants). Pro-fossil fuel. ESG anti-boycott law (SB 13). Climate skeptic.
DEI ban, CRT ban, tenure reform at public universities. 'Strongest pushback to woke policies in higher education.'
Pushed THC ban (SB 3) as top 2025 priority despite GOP backlash. Uses government-mandate logic unusual for liberty conservative.
SB 10 requiring Ten Commandments display in public schools.
SB 15 removing barriers to affordable housing — supply-side deregulation + anti-institutional investor. Bipartisan passage.
Named as 2027 interim charge. Anti-Muslim rhetoric.

votingRecord.chamber: Controls Texas Senate agenda as Lt. Governor (president of Senate)
